name: What's the difference between a general contractor and a specialized accessibility contractor for fall prevention?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a general contractor and a specialized accessibility contractor for fall prevention?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor, like City Dweller, LLC, manages all aspects of a renovation project, including fall prevention modifications, by coordinating various trades (plumbing, electrical, carpentry). They can handle a wide range of projects, from minor installations to major remodels. A specialized accessibility contractor focuses exclusively on accessibility solutions. While both can perform the work, a general contractor offers a broader scope for integrated home improvements, potentially simplifying projects that involve multiple types of modifications beyond just accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: General contractors manage all renovation aspects including accessibility, while specialized contractors focus solely on accessibility. A general contractor offers broader project scope.
